description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D1y_periodic driven by problems/advection_2d_y_periodic_central.esm (the y-axis analog of advection_2d_x_periodic_central). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NY is the open metaparameter (NX is edge-closed at 8; the solution is constant in x and no x-operator appears), and the problem's dy observed and inlined y coordinates use the NY name so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. The manufactured steady solution sin(2 pi y) is held by the exactly matching forcing (derivation in the problem file); the periodic y-operator is skew-symmetric, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure O(dy^2) truncation drift.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
